Package com.codeup.novabook.repo

package com.codeup.novabook.repo
Repository layer providing data access abstractions and implementations.

This package contains the data access layer of the NovaBook system, following the Repository pattern to abstract data persistence operations:

  • Interfaces: Define contracts for data access operations
  • JDBC Implementations: Concrete implementations using JDBC for PostgreSQL

Repository Interfaces:

  • IUserRepository - User data operations
  • IBookRepository - Book data operations
  • IMemberRepository - Member data operations
  • ILoanRepository - Loan data operations

JDBC Implementations:

  • UserRepositoryImpl - PostgreSQL user operations
  • BookRepositoryImpl - PostgreSQL book operations
  • MemberRepositoryImpl - PostgreSQL member operations
  • LoanRepositoryImpl - PostgreSQL loan operations

All repository implementations use JdbcTemplateLight for database operations and follow transactional patterns for data consistency.
